name: The Fan-Out Architecture
coreBlueprint: Handles asynchronous distribution of content from a single producer to millions of followers using push (write-time) or pull (read-time) models.

keyComponents.name: Message Queue
keyComponents.role: Decouples post creation from feed generation.

keyComponents.name: Fan-Out Workers
keyComponents.role: Background workers that duplicate posts into individual user timeline caches.

keyComponents.name: Graph / NoSQL Database
keyComponents.role: Stores user relationships and timeline pointers.
